title: Iron Gold
author: Pierce Brown
summary: The fourth Red Rising book, which picks up years after the first trilogy ends. A solar system in the aftermath of revolution is anything but peaceful, and new viewpoint characters join the old hero as the fighting turns messy.
readIf: you loved the first trilogy and want its action and politics broadened to a wider cast.
skipIf: you haven't read the first three books, as this has major consequences from them.

pairings.reason: A shorter, simpler dystopian fight against a ruling class, if you want the template for this kind of story.
Another multi-viewpoint tale where power changes hands and characters are in real danger.
A more grounded space saga with a similar scale of political and military conflict.
